cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID. The 68% clears two-thirds narrowly; enrolment in the new digital ID was still under way in 27 of 30 districts.
cells.note: NIDA's September 2026 count of over 10 million with biometrics captured is about 68% of the population. It clears two-thirds narrowly and nothing counts 99.9%.
